commits.message:
feat(docs): "Try it" opens any docs example in the playground (rich-playground-afk.4kh) (#239)

* feat(docs): "Try it" opens any docs example in the playground (rich-playground-afk.4kh)

Every example that runs (static, silent, throws, live) carries a "Try it"
link in its output label. It opens the playground on the block as a program of
its own: the block, plus the imports it uses and every statement above it
that declares something it uses (the prelude's console, the page context's
lines, earlier blocks' declarations). Statements above it that change one of
those without printing come along too. docs/.vitepress/example-slice.ts cuts
it using the TypeScript checker's reading of the page's own program.

Checked at build time, per block: the program type-checks alone, and each
block that runs at build time, run as the playground runs it (Sucrase + the
live library), prints the bytes the page shows and ends the same way. Across
the site 206 of 242 executed blocks need nothing from above; all 242 pass.

A page run now fixes the time and a seeded Math.random for every program it
runs, so a block run twice (chain and Try it) agrees; console.log's timestamp
is the one read that differed.

Verified in Chromium (e2e/try-it.spec.ts): Try it on docs/panel.md lands on
the playground with the code and the same rows the page shows; on
docs/progress.md's live track() example, with the page context's doStep, and
the same final frame.

* fix(docs): Try it programs keep the page's scopes and context (rich-playground-afk.4kh)

Review (high) of PR #239:
- a part that redeclares a carried name opens a scope, as the page nests it
- the page's exampleContext is carried whole, so a live block's program,
  which nothing runs at build, is decided by no reading of shape
- a carried statement takes its own comments, not the line before's
- a Try it program that fails to compile, or prints differently, says so
  and names the causes, random numbers among them
- the slicer reads imports through example-program.ts's parser
- never-run blocks are no longer cut

* fix(docs): a throws block's Try it program must throw what the page shows (rich-playground-afk.4kh)

Review (medium) of PR #239: the gate compared only how a run ended, so a
program throwing a different error passed. Both lines now come from one
function, thrownLine, whose source the page program's helper embeds.
The console test matches values of the prelude console's type, not the class.

* fix(docs): one import printer, a thrown line from source text, a callable Date (rich-playground-afk.4kh)

Review (escalation high) of PR #239:
- thrownLine evaluates THROWN_LINE, the text the program embeds, rather
  than pasting a compiled function's toString into the program
- the Date shadow is a Proxy, so Date() returns a string as a host's does
- a Try it program carries every bare import the page ran by its block's end
- example-slice uses example-program's importLines and SourceBuilder
- a non-chain block's checker is not kept past its cut
